test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She has a large, ______ sympathy and absolute fairness of temper.
solution:
The correct answer is **"generous."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Generous"** is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• It means that the person has a large amount of sympathy and is fair. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित रूप से धन, सहायता आदि देने में प्रसन्‍नता अनुभव करने वाला; उदार)
 
 
• **Example**: *It was very **generous**__ of your parents to lend us all that money.*
 
 
 
• The word is used to describe someone who is giving and kind.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *She has a large, __**generous**__ sympathy and absolute fairness of temper.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) mean**: This word means unkind or cruel and does not fit the context of the sentence. (धन आदि स्वयं के लिए रखना न कि दूसरों को देना; कंजूस, स्‍वार्थी)
 
• **Option 2) sparing**: This word means to use or give very little and does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी वस्‍तु के अल्‍प अंश का प्रयोग करते हुए; सावधानीपूर्ण)
 
• **Option 4) thrifty**: This word means to be careful with money and does not fit the context of the sentence. (कमख़र्च, किफ़ायती, किफ़ायतशार, मितव्‍ययी)

The correct answer is **"after a driver."**
